title: Jade🔍+ Sapixcraft Mod Support
description: 🔶 Jade compatibility for Sapixcraft - includes all themes & icons
body:
## Want to use **Sapixcraft** together with [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)?

[Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) is the modern information HUD mod - the successor to Hwyla/WAILA. It shows block names, mob health, furnace progress, chest contents, and more when you look at things in the world.

If the default **Jade tooltip boxes** feel out of place next to Sapixcraft’s UI, this patch fixes that.

This resource pack restyles Jade’s HUD with Sapixcraft-styled tooltip backgrounds, borders, and progress bars - so block info, mob health, and machine readouts all feel like part of the pack.

![key art](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e91a0486bd4683d5011bc70175139894bacdb862.png)

### What this patch changes
- **Tooltip backgrounds** — restyled for all built-in Jade themes
- **Slim borders & nested boxes** — updated to match Sapixcraft’s look
- **Progress bars** — furnace progress, brewing timers, and similar HUD elements

### Restyled Jade themes
Jade ships with several built-in themes. This patch updates all of them:

#### Waila (default)
![Waila theme](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/522b9c8418100d5741f258c9b1347de432514ff3.png)

#### Dark
![Dark theme](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5db3723ccf89495612b004103a0d5c466ea42192.png)

#### Create
![Create theme](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8dc36f0efc832fcf5bfaf4724d80ace3d3033d46.png)

#### One Probe
![One Probe theme](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b570b6d8366a477f85f448c317abe50b756eae76.png)

***
**Load order:** place this mod patch **above** Sapixcraft.

![load order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb09edb3190aac13550c4f7e4726b2eb21ded68b.png)
***

This pack is designed specifically to use with [**Sapixcraft**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sapixcraft) and the [**Jade**](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) mod.

> **Note:** Jade can be installed on the client only, but some features (item storage, brewing stand fuel, bees in beehives, etc.) require Jade on the server as well.
